svg.title: A family of antiderivatives
svg.desc: Five curves y = x cubed over 3 - x + C for C = -2, -1, 0, 1 and 2, each a vertical shift of the others. A dashed vertical line at x = 1.5 crosses all five, and a short tangent segment at each crossing shows the same slope, 1.25, because every curve has derivative x squared - 1.

text.tspan: At x = 1.5 (dashed line) every curve has the same slope, 1.25.
